firm_site:
# Quillwater Ventures

We are an early-stage fund for the plumbing of finance. Quillwater backs India-first fintech infrastructure and B2B software for financial services: payments, lending infrastructure, core banking, treasury, reconciliation, compliance, fraud and account aggregator rails.

We lead or co-lead pre-seed, seed and Series A rounds with first checks of $500K to $3M, in India and US-India cross-border companies.

What we avoid: consumer lending without an in-house risk team, crypto trading platforms, and D2C brands.

lines.speaker: Kabir Shah
lines.text: Thanks for making the time, Maya and Dev. We're excited to start diligence on Lumen.

lines.speaker: Maya Chen
lines.text: Likewise. We have twelve NBFCs live now and reconciliation volumes doubled since June.

lines.speaker: Kabir Shah
lines.text: That's strong. Walk me through how the matching engine handles partial settlements?

lines.speaker: Dev Pillai
lines.text: We split each settlement into legs and match against the ledger in near real time.

lines.speaker: Maya Chen
lines.text: We sent the last investor update a bit late, sorry about that.

lines.speaker: Maya Chen
lines.text: I'll send you the updated deck with the Q3 numbers by the 9th.

lines.speaker: Dev Pillai
lines.text: And I'll share the architecture doc by Monday so your tech advisor can review it.

lines.speaker: Kabir Shah
lines.text: If we move to a partner meeting, we'd want to speak with two of your customers.

lines.speaker: Kabir Shah
lines.text: On our side, I'll put together the cohort analysis questions and send them over before the 21st.

lines.speaker: Maya Chen
lines.text: Perfect, talk soon.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Arjun, good to see you. Let's get you ready for Monday's partner meeting.

lines.speaker: Arjun Khurana
lines.text: Thanks Aditi. Payout volume crossed four million dollars last month across three gig platforms.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: The partners will ask about bank dependency. Who is your sponsor bank today?

lines.speaker: Arjun Khurana
lines.text: One sponsor bank. Our last raise closed in six weeks, but the bank question came up every time.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Fable Bank would be a strong second partner. I'll intro you to Raj Malhotra at Fable Bank by Tuesday.

lines.speaker: Arjun Khurana
lines.text: That would be great. I'll send the updated unit economics by Friday.

lines.speaker: Arjun Khurana
lines.text: If Fable comes on board, we'd launch the second rail in Pune first.

lines.speaker: Arjun Khurana
lines.text: I'll also line up three gig platform references for your team.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Great. See you Monday.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Ishaan, thanks for the quick turnaround on the draft terms.

lines.speaker: Ishaan Verma
lines.text: Of course. The main open points are the option pool and the pro rata language.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: We'd want a board seat if we lead, that's standard for us.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: I'll send you our term sheet markup by Friday.

lines.speaker: Ishaan Verma
lines.text: Thanks. I'll get you the cap table with the ESOP pool by Thursday.

lines.speaker: Ishaan Verma
lines.text: And I'll send you our legal counsel's contact today.

lines.speaker: Aditi Rao
lines.text: Sounds good, speak Thursday.

lines.speaker: Kabir Shah
lines.text: Sid, Arun, quick check-in on diligence.

lines.speaker: Siddharth Menon
lines.text: Sure. The merchant pilot went live last week, as I mentioned on our last call.

lines.speaker: Siddharth Menon
lines.text: I'll send you the customer reference list by Friday.

lines.speaker: Arun Pillai
lines.text: And the security audit report will be with you by Wednesday.

lines.speaker: Kabir Shah
lines.text: Great. I'll share our diligence checklist with you tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Siddharth Menon
lines.text: Perfect, thanks Kabir.

lines.speaker: Meera Iyer
lines.text: Abhishek, thanks for walking us through the model.

lines.speaker: Abhishek Joshi
lines.text: Happy to. Two issuers are live and false positives are down forty percent.

lines.speaker: Meera Iyer
lines.text: I'll send the reference questions by Thursday so you can brief your customers.

lines.speaker: Abhishek Joshi
lines.text: Great. I'll share the fraud loss benchmarks by Wednesday.

lines.speaker: Abhishek Joshi
lines.text: If you're in, we'd love you to take your full pro rata next round.

lines.speaker: Abhishek Joshi
lines.text: I'll also intro you to our design partner at the bank.

lines.speaker: Meera Iyer
lines.text: Thank you, talk soon.

lines.text: Good.

lines.text: And I'll send you a copy of our AA licence today.

lines.speaker: Kabir Shah
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.text: Thanks Aditi.

lines.text: I'll send the bank pipeline list by next Friday.

lines.text: I'll intro you to Omar at Coastline Bank.

lines.speaker: Katherine Fernandes
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.text: Omkar, thanks for the overview of the cross-border rails.

lines.speaker: Omkar Patil
lines.text: I'll give you data room access by Monday.

lines.speaker: Meera Iyer
lines.text: And I'll come back with feedback after our Monday partner meeting.

lines.speaker: Omkar Patil
lines.text: Great.

lines.text: I'll set up a call with Kabir this week.

lines.speaker: Rhea Khosla
lines.text: Thanks Rohan.

lines.text: I'll share the co-op bank partnership deck by next week.

lines.text: Thank you.

lines.text: Thanks both.
